notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded Local Delete Object Instance implementation to the exact official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador declaration exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies the signature, declared exception set, adapter symbol, and real Catch2 selectors. The behavior test proves connection/membership and known-instance boundaries, FederateOwnsAttributes and OwnershipAcquisitionPending rejection, local knowledge removal, retained federation-wide object state, and rediscovery. The focused filesystem-report test proves a rejected unknown-object call appends nothing and an accepted one-argument call appends its type-37 ObjectInstanceHandle record after the local-forget transition. Timestamped/local-delete interactions, DDM, save/restore, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, validation, and conformance remain outside this slice.
